Exchange/platform: Binance
Headline: Binance P2P South Asia Exclusive: Enjoy Zero Maker & Taker Fees on All USDC Trades
Start: 2026-11-17T18:30:00Z · End: 2026-12-18T18:29:00Z
OFFICIAL RULES TEXT:
Fellow Binancians,
Binance P2P is excited to launch a new promotion for eligible users in South Asia. During the Promotion Period, all makers and takers will enjoy zero maker and taker fees on all successful trades for USDC trading pairs on Binance P2P.
Promotion Period: 2026-11-17 18:30 (UTC) to 2026-12-18 18:29 (UTC)
## How to Participate
During the Promotion Period, all verified users who complete the following steps can enjoy zero fees:
For Makers: Post a new advertisement to buy or sell USDC on Binance P2P. You will automatically enjoy zero maker fee on all successful trades from these ads.
For Takers: Buy or sell USDC from any of the available advertisements on the Binance P2P platform to enjoy zero taker fee.
As a maker, you can still set your own price and payment methods, giving you full control over your trades in your local currency, all while being protected by our escrow service. As a taker, you can browse a wide range of live ads, selecting the price and payment method that work best for you, while our escrow service keeps every trade safe.
Trade USDC on P2P Now!
## Guides & Related Materials
Introduction to Binance P2P Trading
Binance P2P Merchant Guidelines
Glossary of P2P Trading Terms
## Terms & Conditions
This promotion is applicable to both makers and takers on Binance P2P for all USDC trading pairs.
Only verified and selected users from South Asia are eligible to participate in this promotion.
The zero maker and taker fees promotion will be applied automatically to all eligible trades during the Promotion Period.
